note: Round-trip transaction cost estimates in basis points (bps). Includes spread + exchange fees. Expressed as percentage for direct use: cost_pct = cost_bps / 100. These are conservative estimates; real costs vary by broker, liquidity, and trade size.

CRYPTO.note: Binance/KuCoin spot taker fee ~7bp each side + avg slippage on top 200 coins

EQUITY.note: US equities: commission-free broker + typical bid-ask spread on liquid names

FOREX.note: Major FX pairs (EUR/USD, USD/JPY): avg spread ~1-2 pips = ~4bp/side

COMMODITY.note: Futures commissions + rollover cost; varies by contract

ETF.note: Same as EQUITY — ETFs trade on exchanges with similar spread structure

BOND.note: Treasury/investment-grade bond ETF; very tight spreads on liquid issues

FUTURES.note: Same as COMMODITY; futures commissions + rollover

UNKNOWN.note: Conservative default for unknown asset class
